headline: Does anything run in rg-webshop-qa at night on the last Tuesday?
scopeLine: 14 resources, about €1,100 a month at the rates on your bill. You are listed as an owner.
question: Activity shows at 02:10 to 02:50 on the last Tuesday of each month, while the environment is otherwise idle at night. Is that a job you need?
whyIAsk: Why I ask: if a job runs then, I will leave the environment on that night. If nothing runs, I will suggest switching it off every night.
